requirements.title: Core UI — Search, History, Ops Panel, and Findings Management Surface
requirements.description: Ship a UI comprising four integrated surfaces: (1) Search box with ranked result display (SearchHit cards with title, URL, snippet, score, source badge, optional L1 synthesis block with citations); (2) Query history panel listing past queries with timestamps and result counts, selectable to replay; (3) Ops panel showing SearXNG engine reachability status, cache hit-rate metric, and remaining budget tokens with a visual indicator; (4) Findings management surface with browse/filter by status, inline edit, supersede action, flag action, and a manual-add form. All surfaces must reflect live state without requiring page reload.

validation.notes: SearchHit card renders all required fields (title, URL, snippet, score, source) given a complete SearchHit fixture
SearchHit card renders gracefully (no crash) given a SearchHit fixture with null snippet
L1 synthesis block is absent from the result view when no synthesis response is present in the result envelope
L1 synthesis block displays citation links that match source URLs in the SearchHit set
Ops panel displays 'unreachable' status for SearXNG when the engine health endpoint returns an error
Findings management browse table renders status badges (active/disputed/superseded) with correct visual differentiation
Manual-add form validates required fields (claim, at least one citation) before submission
Submit a search query and verify results appear without page reload; submit a second query and verify history panel adds an entry
Trigger a live-web query that is cache-served and verify ops panel cache hit-rate increments
Flag a finding via the UI findings management surface and verify the finding status updates to disputed in the database and refreshes in the browse table without page reload
Search results render within 200ms of receiving the first SearchHit from the API
Ops panel metrics refresh at most every 5 seconds without user action
A user can search, review results, inspect system health, and manage findings entirely within the UI without using CLI
The ops panel enables an operator to monitor SearXNG reachability and budget consumption at a glance
